title: Online Club Coaching - Contours
text: For those of you who have yet to sign up to the online club coaching sessions, here's your last chance this winter. Presented by Simon & Clive they have been full of hints and tips and are suitable for all levels. They really are worth attending, you can learn so much from both the coaches and more experienced orienteers on the session, so do sign up.The last session will cover contours and how to make them your friends. It is an informal sessions and will last about an hour. Monday 25th March at 7.30pmPlease email Clive to register your interest and he will email you the zoom link on the day.
